testCase.name: [dev] S20 Backup edges: one backup a day, day 7 kept and day 8 gone, a deleted record leaves the backups after 7 days

descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-04 Data Retention · S20 Backup edges: one backup a day, day 7 kept and day 8 gone, a deleted record leaves the backups after 7 days

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U13 Backups are encrypted, taken daily only, kept 7 days for disaster recovery and documented; the Convex backup setting matches the documented configuration. (UAT OAT-04; UAT OAT-04 step 3; UAT OAT-04 Expected 3; TFA-94699 AC 8; TFA-94703 AC 1 (B4)) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress; TFA-94703 development backlog
  • T5 Deleting a patient hard-deletes all of their data immediately (backups per OAT-04), and the audit log is kept. (TFA-94699 AC 4; UAT TC-24 Expected 5; TFA-92568 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress; TFA-92568 in progress

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given A dedicated scratch Convex deployment created for this test (never , never production), configured with the production backup settings, synthetic data only; synthetic patient 'QA Backup Probe' created on day 0 and deleted on day 1

When List the scratch deployment's backups every day from day 0 to day 9; restore the day-0 backup only into a second scratch deployment on day 7 and try again on day 9. Production backups are only listed, read-only, under S02 by Tim / Daniela and never restored outside production (TFA-94703 B5)

Then Exactly one backup per day; none older than 7 days exists; the day-0 backup (holding the probe) is restorable on day 7 and gone by day 8; no backup taken after day 1 holds the probe

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT OAT-04 Expected 3 ('daily only, kept 7 days') and TC-24 Expected 5 ('backups per OAT-04'): more than one backup in a day, any backup older than 7 days, or the probe in a backup taken after its deletion = Fail. Whether day 7 is inclusive is Q12

Where it ran: dev; test method CONFIG · Config check; lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S20 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-04.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: CONFIG · Config check; secondary: DOC · Document check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on dev; Source: dev.
